content.text: In regions where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-stack-started-generating|The Payment]]-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-one-afternoon-fast|payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible, digital creators face significant challenges in monetizing their work. Countries such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela are just a few examples where conventional payment systems fail. COREMERCH tackles this issue head-on by providing a robust infrastructure for building a crypto store that operates independently of these platforms. This guide will walk you through the deployment of a digital store using Cloudflare Pages, ensuring that you have [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-how-creators-ghana-get-paid-2|COREMERCH guide to complete]] ownership and control over your commerce infrastructure.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often restrict access based on geographical limitations or regulatory hurdles. COREMERCH's architecture bypasses these limitations by leveraging decentralized payment solutions such as NOWPayments, which allow for seamless crypto transactions without KYC requirements. This infrastructure empowers creators to own their online stores fully, mitigating reliance on third-party platforms that can impose sudden restrictions or cease operations. The result is a resilient digital commerce environment where you are in control, free from the vulnerabilities of conventional payment gateways.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before initiating your deployment, ensure you have the necessary tools and accounts set up. You will need a Cloudflare account for hosting, a GitHub account for your code repository, and access to NOWPayments for processing transactions. Familiarize yourself with Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, as these will play key roles in your backend logic and data storage respectively. With these elements prepared, you can efficiently execute your deployment plan and begin building your digital store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by creating a Cloudflare Pages project to host your store. Once your site is set up, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This involves creating an API key and configuring the payment settings to suit your products. Next, leverage Supabase to manage order storage and customer data. This combination ensures that payments are processed securely and products are delivered automatically upon confirmation. Test the entire pipeline to confirm that everything functions as intended before going live.
Infrastructure sovereignty means you own your store, not rent it.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have tested your setup, it's time to launch your store. Promote your store link, ideally your GitHub Pages URL or Cloudflare Pages URL, and encourage potential customers to make purchases. Monitor the payment confirmations through NOWPayments to ensure transactions are processed correctly. Tracking your first transaction will provide valuable insights into any adjustments that may be needed for optimal performance. With this initial sale, you will gain confidence in your infrastructure's reliability.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After establishing a successful store, consider scaling your offerings. You can expand your product range within your existing store or set up multiple stores using the same infrastructure. Utilize the capabilities of Supabase to manage increased user data and orders efficiently. Also, take advantage of Cloudflare Workers to improve performance and enhance the user experience. By continuously optimizing your setup, you can handle increased traffic and sales without sacrificing quality or reliability.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you can use a combination of Cloudflare Pages, GitHub for hosting, and NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup allows you to create a fully operational online store while ensuring complete ownership and control over your digital products and transactions.
Crypto payments allow you to bypass conventional banking restrictions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re exploring options for building a crypto store, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a comprehensive deployment. This stack provides you with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase integration, ensuring a robust infrastructure for your digital products. For additional resources, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long does it take to deploy Stack 01?
Stack 01 can be deployed in approximately 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint. This rapid deployment allows you to start selling your digital products quickly and efficiently.
What differentiates Stack 01 from Stack 02?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script, while Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. Stack 02 is more robust and can be deployed in 48 hours with full testing, making it ideal for those needing a more scalable solution.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on GitHub Pages. However, for added functionality and scalability, consider using Cloudflare Pages, especially if you require backend processing and database capabilities.
Is there a cost involved with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a competitive fee of 0.5% per transaction, making it an affordable solution for processing cryptocurrency payments without KYC requirements.
What support do I get after deploying my store?
After deploying your store with the Edge Commerce Stack, you receive 30 days of support to ensure everything operates smoothly and to address any questions or issues that arise.
Scaling is straightforward with the right infrastructure in place.
